caption:
Keeping your credit card utilization low is one of the simplest ways to protect your credit score. 📊

Utilization measures how much of your total credit limit you spend each month. Credit bureaus prefer to see this number stay under 30%. Paying your balance before your statement closing date can lower this number without changing how you spend.
